text:
sasha: Heads-up: ops flagged multiple tenants with billing spikes tied to v1 after yesterday's v2-rollout. Console showed traffic on v2 but the billing logs say otherwise.

miguel: Do we have repro? Is this header-based routing or something else?

sasha: Quick diff of traces shows `routing_decision`=header but `billing_route`=routed_backend. Example: `X-Client-Version: v1` arrived but final backend was v2 for most requests; some were billed against v1 due to an old accounting path.

rachel: That sounds like our accounting pipeline joining on `header_version` instead of `final_route`. We added `billing_affinity` fields in the audit stream last quarter but not yet wired into billing. Oops.

miguel: Proposed immediate steps: (1) stop-gap: adjust post-processor to prefer `final_route` when present, (2) emit a sampled counter `shadow_route_to_v2` for requests where header!=final_route, (3) add an alert if >2% of requests per-tenant have mismatched billing keys for >10m.

sasha: Also: UX ask for Console: show per-tenant column "route_evidence" with last_header, last_handshake_at, last_final_route, and a small "resync routing" button that triggers a safe re-eval (rate-limited). Net new scope but would reduce ops finger-pointing.

rachel: For the resync endpoint we need audit and a cooldown (no more than 1 per tenant per 5m). The internal endpoint is `POST /internal/tenant/{id}/routing/resync` and currently only clears route cache; can we make it also push a refresh to the billing aggregator?

miguel: We can add a `billing_key_override` flag on the resync call that will replay the last 1m of audit events into billing with corrected route tags. Must be careful: replay could double-bill if not idempotent. We'll gate by replay_idempotency token and ops confirmation.

sasha: Telemetry: add `stale_client_header_alert` for tenants whose `last_handshake_at` is > TTL and client header persists for >30m. That points to client-side caches or proxies.

console-bot: feature-flag rollout: `console.routing-resync-ui` -> 5% orgs (scheduled).

miguel: Rollout plan: implement metric + post-processor patch -> dry-run for 2h across 10% tenants -> check delta in billing meter. If OK, flip for all tenants and enable Console resync UX.

rachel: PR will include unit tests for billing join logic + e2e test that simulates header/final_route mismatch. I'll attach load-job script for local runs.

sasha: Also add an internal banner on Console tenant page when `billing_key_mismatch_rate` > 0.5% with a link to run resync. That'll help CS when customers call.

miguel: Good. Ops: I'll own the dry-run and alert thresholds. Add a short runbook step: if replayed billing > $1000 in a 1h window, pause replay and notify finance.

sasha: Thanks. PR coming shortly. Please review prioritizing the post-processor patch.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `billing/postprocessor-prefer-finalroute` -> canary 15% :rocket:

sasha: Once PR lands, let's coordinate a 1h window with CS and finance on call.
